findings.title: Insecure handling of line terminators in quotes
findings.description: The quote function throws on line terminators for glob patterns but uses inconsistent regex-based sanitization for other inputs.
steps_to_exploit: Pass a token containing line terminators outside the glob context
Observe the output string breaking the shell command context
Attempt to execute injected commands across line breaks

findings.title: Improper Handling of Line Terminators
findings.description: While there are some checks, the logic surrounding line terminator validation is inconsistent across different parsing contexts, potentially allowing CRLF injection.
steps_to_exploit: Attacker crafts a glob pattern containing non-standard line terminators not fully covered by the regex.
The input passes the validation step.
The output is passed to a shell that treats these characters as command separators.
The attacker executes additional unauthorized shell commands.
findings.impact: Command injection via unexpected line termination characters.
